mentions.name: ShopifySharp
mentions.description: A .NET package for Shopify's GraphQL and REST APIs. This update regenerates the GraphQL types and fluent query builders for the July 2026 API version and adds quality-of-life improvements, including F#-friendly features since the package is written in C# but used in F# projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also working on an update to ShopifySharp, the .NET package I maintain for Shopify's graphql and rest APIs. I need to regenerate the graphql types and the fluent query builders for the July 2026 API version that was just released
mentions.author: nozzlegear
